Mr Christopher Harborne.description: A Thailand-based businessman who made his money in aviation and jet fuel trading, and was an early investor in Bitcoin and Ethereum. Reform UK's largest single donor.

Ben Delo.description: Co-founder of BitMEX, a cryptocurrency derivatives exchange. Pleaded guilty in the US in 2022 to a Bank Secrecy Act violation over BitMEX's anti-money-laundering controls, and was pardoned by President Trump in 2025.

Mr Ben Peter Delo.description: Co-founder of BitMEX, a cryptocurrency derivatives exchange. Pleaded guilty in the US in 2022 to a Bank Secrecy Act violation over BitMEX's anti-money-laundering controls, and was pardoned by President Trump in 2025.

Mr David John Grainger.description: A partner at Medicxi, a life-sciences venture capital firm, investing in health, biotech and longevity research.

Nicholas Candy.description: A property developer who, with his brother Christian, built the luxury Candy & Candy development business (including One Hyde Park in London). Left the Conservative Party in December 2024 to become Reform UK's treasurer.

Lord David Sainsbury.description: Former chairman of Sainsbury's supermarkets (1992–1997) and a Labour government science minister (1998–2006). One of the largest individual political donors in British history, having also given large sums to the Liberal Democrats.

Mr Gary Lubner.description: Former CEO of Belron, the parent company of Autoglass, from 2000 to 2023. Trained as a chartered accountant before an MBA at London Business School.

Mr JEREMY HOSKING.description: An investment manager and co-founder of Marathon Asset Management. A major Brexit-era donor (including to Vote Leave), and the founding and principal funder of Laurence Fox's Reclaim Party.

Simon B Ruddick.description: A hedge fund financier who co-founded Albourne Partners, a hedge fund advisory firm.

Neale A Powell-Cook.description: Owner and CEO of Golden Acre Foods; previously Group Finance Director at the dairy company Lactalis.

Mark E Petterson.description: A former BP petroleum engineer who went on to found North Sea Gas Limited and co-found Warwick Energy, a wind power developer.
